findings.description: Device component is routed but not added to dashboard sidebar links. Add `{ label: 'Estado del Dispositivo', route: '/dashboard/device', icon: 'fa-solid fa-microchip' }` to DashboardLayoutComponent links array.
`getApiUrl()` checks `window.__env.apiUrl` but no mechanism loads environment variables at runtime. Either document that this requires a build-time replacement or add a runtime config loader.

Component surfaces camera/microphone permission status but provides no UI to request them (only geolocation and notifications have request buttons). Either add request buttons or remove unsupported permissions from the display.

findings.issue: Session validation uses token presence not validity
findings.description: `loadCriticalFeatures()` calls `authService.isLoggedIn()` which only checks if token exists, not if it's valid or expired. Consider exposing a validity check from AuthService.

Component initializes `loadActivityLog()` in `ngOnInit` before `currentUser$` subscription resolves, logging warning 'Cannot log activity: no user session' on every cold start. Defer activity log load until user ID is available.
Component defines local color variables (`--color-acento: #0891b2`, `--color-principal: #380759`) instead of mapping all values from tokens.scss. Use existing tokens for consistency.

findings.issue: Diagnostic export includes full user agent string
findings.description: User agent can fingerprint browser configuration. Consider stripping or anonymizing it if the diagnostic is shared with untrusted parties (current warning is vague).

findings.issue: Notification permission check duplicates across services
findings.description: `PermissionsService.checkNotificationPermission()` and `Device.requestNotificationPermission()` both check `Notification.permission`. Consolidate logic in the service and call it from the component.

findings.issue: Connection quality API not supported everywhere
findings.description: `getConnectionQuality()` uses `navigator.connection.effectiveType` which is Chromium-only. This is correctly handled with fallback, but the 'No disponible' message could clarify it's not an error, just unsupported.
